snippet.title: YOU DO NOT EXIST - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Want to support us? Please vote for our trailer in Blue Ocean Games' Rising Tide Challenge!
https://linktr.ee/thirteenthmonthstudio

In our debut sci-fi rogue-lite, colonization of our Milky Way has grown wild and untamable. Corporations and governments have joined forces to greenlight humanity's first galactic bounty hunter program. Take on bounties, confront rivals, and find yourself in the middle of a terrible conspiracy as Birdy, a bounty hunter fighting for their future.

Wishlist YOU DO NOT EXIST on Steam!
